objective: R3A global y quirurgico para superficies activas de migracion/publicacion. Eliminar referencias activas a los secrets inexistentes EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER/PASSWORD sin convertir HRLectura en writer: cada workflow conserva preflight READ_ONLY con HRLectura + EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD y falla cerrado antes de cualquier DDL/DML mientras no exista writer autorizado. Scopear EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH=1 solamente al subprocess git push. No tocar docs/memory historicos, runtime SQL, Produccion ni otros legacy pendientes. Todas las modificaciones de archivos existentes quedan protegidas por expected_sha256.

          cur.close(); conn.close()

      - name: Rollback if postcheck failed
        if: steps.postcheck.outcome == 'failure'

          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD }}

        shell: bash

actions.content:
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

MIGRATION_WORKFLOWS = [
    ROOT / '.github/workflows/communications-gate5d-development-migration.yml',
    ROOT / '.github/workflows/catalogo-ampliado-gate8f-development-migration.yml',
    ROOT / '.github/workflows/cavas-corporativas-menu-development-migration.yml',
    ROOT / '.github/workflows/cavas-gate12i-persona-link-development-migration.yml',
]

PUBLISHERS = [
    ROOT / 'backup_a_github.sh',
    ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/publish_local_snapshot.sh',
    ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/finalize_local_snapshot.sh',
]

def test_active_migration_workflows_fail_closed_without_legacy_migration_secrets():
    for path in MIGRATION_WORKFLOWS:
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        assert 'EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_USER' not in text
        assert 'EDARSAHUB_SQL_MIGRATION_PASSWORD' not in text
        assert 'MIGRATION_WRITER_STATUS=UNCONFIGURED' in text
        assert 'HRLECTURA_WRITER_FORBIDDEN=YES' in text
        assert 'secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD' in text

def test_publish_authorization_is_scoped_to_git_push_only():
    for path in PUBLISHERS:
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        assert 'export EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH=1' not in text
        assert 'EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH=1 git push' in text
